text:
anya: Proposal: add a tiny "skim" step in intake that runs sub-15s structural checks before enqueuing the full bench. Goal: faster owner feedback + avoid burning bench-hours on obvious failures.

miko: Sounds good. What checks?

anya: Minimal list: manifest lint (required fields, shapes), one-step infer (seq=8, batch=1) on cheap infra, converter --dry-validate. If infer OOMs or driver errors -> mark PROBE_OOM/DRV_ERROR and skip bench.

tara: We need machine-readable failure codes for automation + remediation links. Also retryable infra errors should auto-retry (2x).

anya: Agreed. Codes planned: SKIM_OK, SKIM_SHAPE_MISMATCH, SKIM_OOM, SKIM_OP_MISSING, SKIM_INFRA_RETRYABLE. Backoff: 2 retries, 30s then 60s.

miko: For custom kernels add a flag in manifest: custom_kernels: true so skim uses shim loader. Also add UI override: force_full_bench with audit note.

intake-bot: Created MR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/intake/merge_requests/118 - skim harness + schema change. CI job: skim-smoke added. :white_check_mark:

tara: Metrics: intake.skim_skip_count, intake.skim_feedback_latency_s, intake.skim_retries. I'll build a dashboard.

anya: Rollout: 10d internal canary -> opt-in partners -> default-on after metrics review. Action items: anya (MR follow-up + docs), miko (override + shim support), tara (dashboard). Due: next Mon.
